key_insight: DynaWeb adapts model-based reinforcement learning to web agents by learning a differentiable world model of web interactions, enabling safe, efficient simulated training of agents that perform browsing tasks without extensive live internet access.
problem_solved: Training autonomous web agents via online interactions is slow, expensive, and risky (privacy, breakage, costs). DynaWeb reduces dependence on live web access while improving sample efficiency and safety.
method: Learn a web world model that predicts DOM/state transitions and outcomes of actions (click, type, navigate) from agent interactions.
Use imagined rollouts from the learned model to train policies (Dyna-style planning + model-based updates), with periodic grounding on limited real web data to correct model bias.
Incorporate uncertainty estimation (e.g., ensembles) and adaptive real-environment querying to avoid compounding model errors and ensure robust sim-to-real transfer.
impact: Enables faster, cheaper, and safer development of web agents by cutting live-web data needs and improving sample efficiency—lowering the barrier to deploying capable autonomous web assistants.
